description: Demolition of an existing rear conservatory/rear infill extension and replacement with a single storey flat roofed full width rear extension the the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (AM_2021_PL001, AM_2021_PL002, AM_2021_PL100, AM_2021_PL101, AM_2021_PL102, AM_2021_PL104, AM_2021_PL105, AM_2021_PL106, AM_2021_PL107, AM_2021_PL200revB, AM_2021_PL201revB, AM_2021_PL202revB, AM_2021_PL204revB, AM_2021_PL205revB, AM_2021_PL206revB, AM_2021_PL207revB, Design & Access Statement, Fire Safety Strategy received 18 January 2022) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
